create_named_discrete_space: create a NamedDiscrete space with named items like 'a', 'b', 'c' for a discrete action space
lookup_named_discrete_index: lookup the numeric index of a named item in a NamedDiscrete space using bracket notation
convert_actions_to_string: convert numeric action values to their human-readable string names using the to_string method
parse_string_to_actions: parse a space-separated string of names into numeric action values using the from_string method
compare_named_discrete_spaces: compare two NamedDiscrete spaces for equality checking names, order, and space name
